CONTRADICTION / TRAP: every Genius, GeniusPRO, GEN and GENPRO guide contains the sentence "Canbus is enabled in Standby mode." NOCO never defines it anywhere in any guide read here — no connector, no bitrate, no message list, no pinout. It appears in the Standby row of the charge-mode table alongside Energy Save, i.e.

Charging voltages are stated per mode in the guide (GENIUS10: 14.5 V 12V, 14.8 V 12V AGM, 14.6 V 12V LITHIUM, 7.25 V 6V, 7.4 V 6V AGM, 13.6 V SUPPLY, up to 16.5 V REPAIR) — useful for sizing, useless for a driver.
IP65, 150 W max, 10 A at 12 V, up to 230 Ah. Auto-memory returns to the last mode on power-up, which means a power cycle does not reset a unit left in SUPPLY or REPAIR.
